description.value: FUNK Coffee Bar is a specialty coffee roaster and café in downtown Vancouver's financial district, serving vibrant single-origin coffees alongside breakfast and lunch eats. The venue doubles as a 138-person event space with a lounge area, boardroom catering, and outdoor seating. A subscription coffee box program and in-house-designed brewing gear make it a destination for serious coffee enthusiasts passing through the city core.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 62m; stands (5 spaces) at 70m; stands (5 spaces) at 78m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active specialty coffee bar and roaster at 1025 Dunsmuir St, Vancouver, matching the OSM address; the 'Order Pickup' navigation link on the website confirms takeout is available. The event bookings page explicitly lists '✔ Free Wifi' as a rental feature, corroborating OSM internet_access=wlan/fee=no. Washrooms are implied by the OSM changing_table=yes tag (a changing table inherently requires a washroom), and the event bookings page notes wheelchair accessibility, further indicating accessible washrooms exist.
concerns: OSM amenity tag is 'bar' but the business is clearly a coffee shop/café (cuisine=coffee_shop;breakfast;lunch); the name and website confirm it is not primarily a bar — OSM may benefit from amenity=cafe.
OSM name uses lowercase 'coffee bar' whereas the website renders it as 'FUNK Coffee Bar' in most contexts; minor capitalization discrepancy.
Phone number not explicitly displayed in website content — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible specialty coffee bar and café in downtown Vancouver; website is live and confirms the OSM location.
